data.one_liner: A flexible version of Flutter's ColorScheme.fromSeed supporting multiple seed colors and custom tones.
data.what_it_does: FlexSeedScheme extends ColorScheme.fromSeed by allowing separate seed key colors for primary, secondary, tertiary, error, and neutral palettes. It also supports custom chroma limits, tone mappings, and Material 3 dynamic scheme variants.
use_when: You need separate seed colors for primary, secondary, and tertiary palettes instead of a single seed color.
You want to customize chroma and tone mapping behavior in generated ColorSchemes.
You need monochrome seed colors to produce correct greyscale palettes.
avoid_when: You are satisfied with the default single-seed behavior of Flutter's built-in ColorScheme.fromSeed.
You do not use Material 3 color systems.
strengths: Supports up to six separate seed key colors for fine-grained color generation.
Provides multiple predefined FlexTones configurations like vivid, highContrast, and material.
Allows custom chroma and tone mappings in the HCT color space.
weaknesses: Requires learning additional custom configuration classes like FlexTones.
Relies heavily on Material 3 design paradigms.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import it where you configure your MaterialApp themes.

alternatives.name: flex_color_scheme
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a complete color scheme and theme builder package with dozens of ready-made themes and extensive surface customization rather than just an extended fromSeed function.
